publications.summary: A geometric framework for controlling stylistic attributes in language-model representations while preserving semantic content.
publications.contribution: Combines contrastive objectives, identity-preserving constraints, and semantic regularization for representation-level intervention.
publications.result: Manuscript in preparation; evaluation covers attribute control, semantic preservation, representation geometry, and LLM-based judgment.
publications.citation: Tiwari, K., Zhang, L. Counterfactual Text Generation via Geometric Style Control in Large Language Models.

publications.summary: Studies adversarial NLP through the Minimum Description Length principle rather than directly modeling every perturbation strategy.
publications.contribution: Uses masked language modeling to estimate the information required to transform original text into an adversarial variant.
publications.result: Provides a signal for detecting altered tokens and adversarial manipulation without access to the original input.
publications.citation: Tiwari, K., Zhang, L. (2024). Implications of Minimum Description Length for Adversarial Attack in Natural Language Processing. Entropy, 26(5), 354.

publications.summary: Introduces CEBERT, a causal-regularization approach that reduces reliance on spurious lexical correlations in hate speech detection.
publications.contribution: Models hate speech classification with a causal graph and integrates causal strength into a regularized entropy objective.
publications.result: Reached 85.9% accuracy under word replacement and 86.0% under misspelling attacks, above the strongest reported baselines of 70.3% and 73.7%.
publications.citation: Tiwari, K., Yuan, S., Zhang, L. (2022). Robust Hate Speech Detection via Mitigating Spurious Correlations. Proceedings of AACL-IJCNLP 2022 (Short Papers), 51-56.
